caption: The drawing depicts a tombstone-shaped object with a rectangular lower section and a semicircular arch at the top center, framed by inward-stepped shoulders on each side. The central area of the object is filled with a dark, shaded texture, while the upper curved portion and the vertical borders are decorated with swirling, leafy scrollwork patterns rendered in black and gray graphite. The numerals "1764" are written in a plain style near the top center, inside the arch. The object is set against a plain, light background, and there are faint, precisely measured pencil lines forming a wider rectangular boundary around the main object, as well as a smaller technical drawing or diagram near the bottom right corner of the page. The overall composition is monochromatic, using shades of gray and black pencil or graphite on an off-white or beige paper.
title: Iron Fireback
